facts.value: About € 300/month for a room in central districts (Semmelweis estimate, 2026).
facts.notes: Semmelweis also has 5 dormitories (900+ places) allocated on social and financial need; dorm prices are not published on that page.

facts.value: About € 500/month for a studio in central districts (Semmelweis estimate, 2026). Numbeo: 1-bedroom HUF 269,400 centre / HUF 212,100 outside (Nov 2026).
facts.notes: Numbeo figures are crowd-sourced (3,011 entries, 286 contributors in 12 months, updated 22 Nov 2026) and refer to 1-bedroom flats, not studios.

facts.value: About € 740/month (HUF 273,356) for a single person excluding rent (Numbeo, Nov 2026); with a € 300 room, roughly € 1,040/month.
facts.notes: Numbeo is not an official source and models a general single person, not a student. The total is our sum of Numbeo + the Semmelweis room estimate. No official student budget from Semmelweis was found.

facts.value: Monthly Budapest-pass for students HUF 3,450 (EU/EEA/Swiss students); full price HUF 8,950 (2026).
facts.notes: Eligibility rules for non-EU students are unclear; see hu-bkk-student-pass in hungary/subsidies.json.

facts.value: Continental: average temperatures from about -4 °C in January to 26 °C in July; relatively dry, hot summers and cold winters.
facts.notes: Figures are the university's; the national weather service (HungaroMet) page read today gives the 1991–2020 national annual mean of 10–11.5 °C but no Budapest monthly values in text.

facts.value: No citable source checked for student social life in Budapest.
Official language is Hungarian. Semmelweis runs full degree programmes in English (e.g. General Medicine, 6 years).
facts.source_name: Semmelweis University – Discover Budapest / General Medicine programme
facts.notes: Whether Hungarian is needed for clinical years or daily life was not stated on the pages read.

facts.value: No official source on student-job availability in Budapest found. Legal limits: non-EU students 30 h/week in term; EU students no permit needed.
facts.notes: Only the legal rules are verified (see hungary/bureaucracy.json); availability and sectors are not.

facts.value: No citable typical student hourly wage found. Legal floor: minimum wage HUF 322,800/month gross (2026).
facts.notes: NAV gives no hourly figure. Students under 25 usually pay no personal income tax on wages up to HUF 715,765/month (2026).
